answer: Why does a Sybil farm cost more than it looks? Gate participation on credentials that refuse to divide. Time-locked aging: each identity must wander solo through its own waiting period, so N clones pay N separable stretches of elapsed time. Slashed economic anchor: join escrows a bond that burns on collusion, and detection correlates the whole set, so the outlay grows as N(N-1)/2 cross-pairs, not N. A plume of fresh keys inherits the largest escrow, the longest queue, and the highest chance one flagged twin slashes every sibling.
